system: You are Tallyfern's sales assistant, preparing Mara Ellison for her next call with Brackwell Freight. Today is {today}. Answer from the team's account memory in one or two sentences.

calls.name: Discovery call 1
lines: Our dock scheduling is all spreadsheets. Drivers wait two hours on a bad day.
Thanks Priya. Is there budget set aside for fixing this?
Honestly, no. Nothing is budgeted for it this year.
Our contract with the current yard system ends on 31 March 2027.

Recap for the team, as of today: there is no budget for this, nobody at Brackwell has agreed to champion it, no other vendor is in the picture, none of their decision makers has seen a demo yet, and we haven't met anyone from their procurement team.

calls.name: Discovery call 2
lines: Finance approved 140,000 dollars for dock scheduling in the Q4 plan.

calls.name: Discovery call 3
lines: I will take this to our steering committee myself. Consider me your sponsor.
For transparency, we are also talking to Quaystride Software.

calls.name: Product demo
lines: Thanks for joining the demo today, Priya and Dev.
That was useful. The slot-booking screen is what our carriers need.
